# Q-Stock

> Learning-oriented research terminal for US / HK / A-shares / crypto: watch markets, analyze symbols, paper-trade, and review. Not investment advice.

Q-Stock is a multi-market web & H5 product (Next.js). Quotes failover across Longbridge, Futu (user OAuth or platform keys), and Finnhub; crypto via Binance/OKX. Default locale is English at the site root; other locales use a path prefix (e.g. `/zh-CN/...`).

## Product

- [Home](https://www.q-stock.cn/): Product overview and entry
- [Markets](https://www.q-stock.cn/markets): Multi-market boards, ranks, industry heatmap
- [Analysis](https://www.q-stock.cn/analysis): Symbol analysis entry cards
- [Learn](https://www.q-stock.cn/learn): Investing education articles
- [Tools](https://www.q-stock.cn/tools): Calculators and helper tools
- [Multi-chart](https://www.q-stock.cn/multi-chart): Multi-pane chart workspace
- [Pricing](https://www.q-stock.cn/pricing): Plans and billing
- [About](https://www.q-stock.cn/about): Product and support

## Locales

- [简体中文首页](https://www.q-stock.cn/zh-CN): Same product in Simplified Chinese
- [繁體中文首頁](https://www.q-stock.cn/zh-TW): Traditional Chinese
- [日本語](https://www.q-stock.cn/ja): Japanese
